persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make me a wide watercolor picture of a red-and-white striped lighthouse on a rocky coast at dusk. No writing.
bank.Which picture: The lighthouse watercolor generated in the first turn.
bank.Style and setting: Keep the watercolor look, rocky coast and dusk lighting from the picture.
bank.Motion: Small waves roll against the rocks and the lighthouse beam slowly sweeps across the water.

messages.text: I'd like you to make me a watercolor picture of a lighthouse. I've always found coastal scenes calming, so that's why I'm asking for this. The lighthouse should be red-and-white striped, and the picture should be wide. Put it on a rocky coast at dusk. I sometimes worry that I over-explain simple picture ideas, but I just want to make sure I've described what I mean. Please don't include any writing.
